structural_chain_summary: (1) K prime in S^3 [Kneser-Stallings, Lemma PUP.3.2]
(2) AKN tile-substitution rho_K primitive [unproved extension; Anderson-Putnam 1998 supplies substitution-tiling machinery, not S^3 \ K construction]
(3) Perron-Frobenius: A_K has unique max-modulus eigenvalue [HJ85 Thm 8.5.1]
(4) Perron eigenvalue is algebraic; irrationality requires excluding rational-root degeneracies [Lind-Marcus 1995 Sec 11.1]
(5) AF core F_{A_K}=O_{A_K}^T carries dimension-group state; O_{A_K} is non-tracial
(6) meridian trace identity remains on B_K subset C_r^*(Gamma_K); convergence and trace descent from the M_2(C) surrogate remain open
closure_status: The general-prime extension of the superseded trefoil surrogate (App PUP Sec PUP.6.3a/6.3b) is not complete. It would need (A) the Anderson-Putnam-style C*-algebra extension from R^n tile spaces to substitution structures on S^3 \ K, (B) canonicity of K |-> A_K, (C) a controlled meridian representation with convergence and trace descent (Open Problem O.18), (D) KO-dim-6 sign verification (O.32), and the declared complement-compatible full-fibre supports D_n=X_n x K_n. The inverse limit is a pro-group of generally infinite groups, not a profinite group. O.35/O.36 fail as posed for the represented trefoil group B_3 and hold only for the further central quotient B_3/Z(B_3) = C_2*C_3; whether any physical sector is that quotient regular representation is open (Tier 3). Under an assumed factorial sector, Prop. PUP.1(iii) gives uniqueness of R_inv only, not of F_sel. The physical support, inverse-limit and factorial-sector identifications remain open; the ceiling is an algebraic unity candidate (Tier 3 conditional).

remaining_open: The AKN tile-substitution rho_K primitive remains an unproved extension: Anderson-Putnam 1998 supplies substitution-tiling machinery, not the S^3 \ K construction. A fully self-contained GCT-internal derivation would require constructing the AKN substitution, proving primitivity, and proving recognizability inside this protocol.
